 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>EXHIBIT 3.2 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>FIDELITY 2022 CORE REAL ESTATE TRUST </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>CERTIFICATE OF AMENDMENT </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">THIS IS TO
CERTIFY THAT: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1. The Certificate of Trust (the &#8220;Certificate&#8221;) of Fidelity 2022 Core Real Estate Trust, a Maryland statutory
trust (the &#8220;Trust&#8221;), is hereby amended by deleting Article Second of the Certificate in its entirety and substituting the following in lieu thereof: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>SECOND</U></B>: The name of the statutory trust (the &#8220;Trust&#8221;) is: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Fidelity Core Real Estate Trust </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2. The undersigned acknowledges under the penalties of perjury that, to the best of its knowledge and belief, the facts stated herein are
true. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">[REMAINDER OF THIS PAGE INTENTIONALLY LEFT BLANK] </P>
